text: Mobile app development is an exciting field with many important decisions. One key idea is responsive design, which means apps should work well on different screen sizes and devices. Developers also choose between native and cross-platform approaches. Native apps are built for one platform, such as iOS or Android, and often offer the best performance. Cross-platform apps work on several platforms at once, which saves time and money. After development, apps are usually published on app stores like Google Play or the App Store. Finally, performance matters a lot because users expect apps to be fast, smooth, and reliable.
